final: WITH j AS (SELECT r.ordervault AS ordervault, o.orderflow AS orderflow, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), s AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share FROM j), a AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt, share, share - avg_share AS diff FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
